main.description:
Import an existing account as a stewarded arbiter.

The caller provides an app password proving control of the account.
The server stores the credentials, writes the service + recovery records
from the account's session, and brings the arbiter online.

arbiterDid.description: The DID of the account to import.

appPassword.description: App password for the PDS account.

pdsUrl.description: Optional PDS URL. If omitted, resolved from the DID's #atproto_pds.

errors.name: ErrPermissionDenied
errors.description: The requesting user is not allowed to import an arbiter.

errors.name: ErrArbiterAlreadyExists
errors.description: An arbiter for this DID already exists on this server.
